rules: NEVER use generic fonts for headings. Always apply tracking-tight to headings.
Use JetBrains Mono for timecodes, sliders, toggles, and metadata.
Ensure hierarchy jump rule: maximum 2 Tailwind steps between heading and subheading.

strategy: Use Deep Obsidian base (#0A0A0A). Do not use pure black (#000000) for surfaces to maintain depth.
Primary Accent: Cyber Yellow (#D4FF00). Use for active states, selected words in transcript, main CTA (Export).
Hover text: Always apply explicit hover states (e.g., hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800).
Avoid 'SaaS Blue' or generic purples. This is a high-energy creator tool.

left_rail.description: Media Library, Project List, Video Upload Dropzone.
left_rail.style: bg-[#09090b] border-r border-zinc-800/50 p-6 flex flex-col gap-6

center_canvas.description: Video Preview Player, Transport Controls, Auto-Cut Toggle, Caption Style Gallery.
center_canvas.style: bg-[#000000] relative flex flex-col p-8 overflow-y-auto

right_rail.description: Word Timeline, Transcript Editor, Cut Markers.
right_rail.style: bg-[#09090b] border-l border-zinc-800/50 p-6 flex flex-col gap-4 shadow-xl

layout.grid_bento: Use dense Grid borders for the Caption Style Gallery (e.g., grid-cols-2 gap-4) in the center pane below the player.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp edges (rounded-md). Main Export button MUST be bright Cyber Yellow (bg-primary text-black) with hover scale-up.
components.upload_dropzone: Dashed border. On hover, border turns Cyber Yellow and background tints slightly. Use a large upload icon.
components.caption_cards: Dark grey cards with 1px border. When selected, border becomes 2px Cyber Yellow and an inner glow applies.
components.sliders: Auto-cut slider uses Cyber Yellow track. Minimalist thumb.
components.transcript_words: Words are rendered as inline blocks. Active/playing word gets bg-primary/20 and text-primary. Filler words marked with faint red underline or strikethrough.
components.toggle: Shadcn switch, customized to use Cyber Yellow when checked.

interactions: Hovering interactive elements should slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and brighten.
Caption words in the preview canvas should bounce or pop in (staggered Framer Motion).
Smooth layout transitions when panels collapse or expand.

video_poster_placeholder.description: A woman talking to the camera, used as a placeholder for the video player.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Favor minimalist, technical icons (e.g., Scissors for Auto-Cut, Wand for Styles, Play/Pause for transport).

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install Google Fonts (Outfit, Inter, JetBrains Mono) in index.html or global css. Setup Tailwind CSS with the provided variables.
instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Build a full-screen layout (h-screen w-full flex overflow-hidden). Never let the body scroll; scroll inside the specific panels.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_components: Install and heavily customize slider, switch, button, scroll-area, tabs, card.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (e.g., 'upload-dropzone', 'auto-cut-slider', 'export-button', 'transcript-word').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use the 3-pane asymmetric layout exactly as described.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; prefer solid obsidian panels for this pro tool.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Align text to the left.
Always use modern button styles (Cyber Yellow pill for Export).
NEVER use Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static = dead.
Ensure the UI feels like a professional video editing command center, not a generic SaaS form.
